svg.title: tmux-orchestrator
svg.desc: Agent activity becomes lifecycle events. The reporter turns each event into one of six states, stores it in tmux user options, and tmux renders it as a clickable sidebar. Clicking a row jumps to the agent pane, and background sessions are supported.
svg.text: Every agent, every session, one click away.

g.text: session status rolls up agent statuses
Click any row to jump to its pane.
